notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Thank you for your recent purchase of NextFX. Effective July 14, 2018, the default version of NextFX available via early-access is updated from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0.

This update prevents errors that occur when using NextFX with first-person games that lock and hide the cursor, and extends NextFX compatibility to titles like Skyrim and Fallout. The “help” tab has also been augmented to include instructions to assist new users with the software.

If you have questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out as we are constantly updating the product and welcome any feedback or recommendations. 

Happy modding, 
The NextFX Product Team
